verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a built-in AI Agent that builds and edits 3D scenes from natural-language descriptions, covering objects, materials, lighting, animation and interactivity. A parallel Hana agent designs 2D screens from a description, and an MCP server lets external AI clients drive the open editor. Typed-prompt texture and 3D generation add further natural-language entry points. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language agent works as claimed (all evidence is vendor docs).
